improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon: a Claude-powered AI assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with 3 free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-gideon-preview.png">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://gdn.ai/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon is, who it serves, and the free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the price anchor and free searches removes friction and sets clear expectations before the click.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — the intelligent assistant built to help you make faster decisions, streamline operations, and grow with confidence. Try three free searches and see the difference."
improvements.rationale: The headline positions Gideon as a partnership rather than just a tool, building trust with business professionals. The subheading immediately communicates three core benefits (speed, efficiency, growth), introduces the brand name, and leads with the free trial offer to reduce friction and encourage immediate engagement. Copy stays factual and avoids unverified claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30% with an annual plan. As a member, you unlock unlimited searches, voice chat, and a dedicated workspace built for trade and business professionals.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common conversion barrier—what happens at the paywall. It reassures prospects by clearly explaining the transition, emphasizing low entry cost, and highlighting the value unlocked with membership. Transparency builds trust and reduces friction at the decision point.
